title: moderation.submit
description: Open (or find) a moderation case for one target — the explicit submission path for a module that has no event worth publishing. Idempotent by state: an already-open case for the same target is returned rather than duplicated. Response: {"case_id": string, "state": string, "created": boolean}.

target_type.description: Registry key; an unregistered type raises.

target_key.description: Opaque host key of the target.
